skirmish.module.region_bounds.name: Region Bounds
skirmish.module.region_bounds.descriptio: Aim at a region block with its hologram and the area it protects is outlined in the world, with a pill on top: kind, size and how many blocks to the edge. Sizes from the HolyWorld wiki; Lite and Prime differ.
skirmish.module.region_bounds.setting.se: Region sizes differ on Lite and Prime. Auto takes it from the Events module (sidebar, tab list), otherwise from the block itself
skirmish.module.region_bounds.setting.ra: How far the block under the crosshair is recognised
skirmish.module.region_bounds.setting.ho: How long the outline stays after you look away
skirmish.module.region_bounds.setting.wa: Translucent walls along the border besides the lines
skirmish.module.region_bounds.setting.ho: Only when a region hologram hangs above the block (otherwise any such block)
skirmish.module.region_bounds.setting.hu: Pill on top: region kind, size and distance to the edge
